settings.intro: A quiet, art-deco inspired hotel in Downtown Cairo — warm light, soft brass, spotless rooms and a team that is awake when you are.
settings.address: 16a 26 July St, Al Fawalah, Abdeen, Cairo
settings.mapQuery: CALMA Hotel, 16a 26 July St, Abdeen, Cairo

rooms.name: Single Room
rooms.short: A calm room for one, facing the street through a window or balcony.
rooms.description: A quiet, comfortable room for the solo traveller — warm lighting, a vanity with a backlit mirror and everything you need for a restful night. Facing the street, with a window or a balcony.

rooms.name: Deluxe Double Room
rooms.short: One double bed or two single beds, facing the street through a window or balcony.
rooms.description: Choose one generous double bed or two single beds — tell us which when you book. A proper desk for slow mornings with a laptop, softer furnishings throughout, and a window or balcony onto the street.

rooms.name: Classic Twin Room
rooms.short: Two beds, warm wood and tall windows — ideal for friends.
rooms.description: Two beds beneath tall shuttered windows, framed art and a warm wood headboard wall. Our most requested room for friends travelling together, and for guests who like a little more space either side of the bed.

rooms.name: Triple Room
rooms.short: Three single beds in one warm room, facing the street — friends or a small family.
rooms.description: Three beds dressed in warm linens beneath soft brass wall lighting, with a window or balcony onto the street. Built for three friends or a small family who would rather share one warm room than split across two.

rooms.name: Luxury Triple Room
rooms.short: Three beds, upgraded finishes and a window or balcony onto the street.
rooms.description: Our most refined room for three. Three comfortable beds dressed in premium linens, warm brass lighting and upgraded finishes throughout — with plenty of space to settle in. A window or balcony opens onto the street, and every stay includes breakfast, daily housekeeping, laundry service and our 24-hour reception. Ideal for friends or a small family who want a little more comfort.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.short: Four beds, space to spread out and a big window.
rooms.description: Multiple beds set within one warm, wood-floored room — comfortable enough for a family or a small group to share without feeling crowded, with full-length curtains to keep it restful even in daylight.

rooms.name: Modern Suite
rooms.short: Double bed, sitting corner and our most contemporary finish.
rooms.description: Our most contemporary stay — clean lines, a small round table for breakfast in the room, a backlit vanity and low, warm lighting throughout.

journeys.title: The Calm Welcome
journeys.description: We track your flight, arrange a private pickup from Cairo International Airport, and have your room ready — followed by a short orientation of the neighbourhood.

journeys.title: Pyramids & Saqqara
journeys.description: The Giza Plateau and the quieter Step Pyramid at Saqqara with a private, licensed guide and a driver who paces the day sensibly. Lunch at a local restaurant along the way.

journeys.title: Old Cairo on Foot
journeys.description: A walking route through Islamic Cairo's minarets and stone alleys, ending at Khan El Khalili for tea and a slow browse through the market.

journeys.title: Egyptian Museum, Properly Explained
journeys.description: Our guide narrows the collection down to the pieces worth your time, including the Tutankhamun treasures, and explains the history in plain terms.

journeys.title: Evening on the Nile
journeys.description: A quiet hour on the water as the city's light softens — a gentle way to close a busy day of sightseeing.

reviews.text: The kind of stay that resets you before you've even unpacked — quiet, warm, and genuinely well looked after.
reviews.author: A recent guest

faq.a: Choose your dates and guests, pick a room and send your details. You get a booking code instantly and our team confirms on WhatsApp.

faq.q: What is included in the price?
faq.a: Every room includes breakfast, air conditioning, hot water, a TV, free Wi-Fi, housekeeping, laundry service and our 24-hour reception.

faq.q: Do the rooms have a view?
faq.a: Our single, double and triple rooms all face the street, with either a window or a balcony.
No card is needed to send a booking request. Our team confirms availability and payment details with you directly.

faq.q: Why book direct instead of Booking.com?
faq.a: Same rooms and the same service, without the platform commission — so you pay less when you book on this website.

faq.q: Can you arrange an airport pickup?
faq.a: Yes. Add it in the notes when you book, or message us on WhatsApp with your flight details.
There is no parking at the hotel itself, but there is public parking close by — ask reception and we will point you to it.
Yes — airport transfers and day trips to the Pyramids, Old Cairo, the Egyptian Museum and the Nile. Ask us on WhatsApp or at reception.
